name: Blue Eyes
source:
A.D. 2215. Aliens coexist with humans on the Earth. A team of killers, containing Matis, Selica and Joiness, creates an uproar on the streets of Tokyo. This time they killed the most powerful mafia boss and took three black crystals called "Blue Eyes". However, they get involved in a terrible incident over the "Blue Eyes".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-august-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
公元2215年，外星人与地球上的人类共存。由马蒂斯、塞利卡和乔尼斯组成的杀手团队在东京街头制造了轩然大波。这次他们击杀了最强大的黑手党老大，拿走了三颗名为“蓝眼睛”的黑色水晶。然而，他们因“蓝眼睛”而卷入了一场可怕的事件。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-august-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
